description: Capture golden outputs from the Python CLI (stdout bytes, stderr bytes, exit code) per (subcommand × fake_ccusage fixture mode), including malformed args, missing executable, invalid JSON, TTY/non-TTY. title: Golden capture + dual-run parity harness
